topic.label: Aeronautics and Astronautics
topic.desc: Aeronautics and Astronautics: the science and engineering of aircraft and spacecraft, from aerodynamics and propulsion to orbital mechanics, structures and flight control.

concepts: Flow of air over wings, bodies and inlets, covering lift, drag, boundary layers and compressible shock behaviour at subsonic to hypersonic speeds.
Generation of thrust by air-breathing engines and rockets, analysed through thermodynamic cycles, nozzle flow and specific impulse.
Lightweight airframe and spacecraft structures, their loads, stresses, buckling, fatigue and composite materials.
Aircraft equations of motion, stability derivatives and feedback control laws that keep vehicles stable and on path.
Motion of spacecraft under gravity, including Keplerian orbits, transfers, perturbations and rendezvous.
Design of spacecraft subsystems such as power, thermal, attitude and communications, integrated against mission requirements.
skills: Computes lift and drag coefficients across angle of attack for an airfoil and checks them against thin-airfoil theory and published wind tunnel polars.
Solves isentropic, normal shock and oblique shock relations for a given Mach number and checks results for conservation of mass, momentum and energy.
Sizes wing area, aspect ratio and sweep for a cruise condition and checks induced drag and stall margin against the requirements.
Runs an ideal and real Brayton cycle for a turbojet or turbofan and reports thrust and fuel consumption, checked by an energy balance.
Computes specific impulse, nozzle expansion and delta-v from propellant data and checks the result with the rocket equation.
Reviews a combustor or injector design for instability risks and checks the findings against documented test literature.
Calculates bending and shear stresses in a wing box under flight loads and checks margins of safety against material allowables.
Estimates critical buckling loads for stiffened panels and checks them against finite element results or handbook curves.
Recommends a composite ply layup for a part and checks stiffness and failure indices with laminate theory.
Derives longitudinal and lateral modes from stability derivatives and checks damping and frequency against handling qualities criteria.
Designs a feedback controller for pitch or heading hold and checks gain and phase margins in a simulated step response.
Plans and validates a drone survey mission through the MAVLink interface, with preflight checks reviewed before upload.
Computes Hohmann and bi-elliptic transfer delta-v between orbits and checks the totals by energy and vis-viva equations.
Propagates a spacecraft trajectory with J2 and drag perturbations and checks the drift against analytic secular rates.
Identifies launch windows and rendezvous opportunities for a target orbit and checks the timing against published mission data.
Builds power and mass budgets for spacecraft subsystems and checks the totals for margin against mission requirements.
Computes equilibrium temperatures from solar, albedo and internal heat loads and checks them against component limits.
Traces mission requirements to subsystem design choices and checks each trace against prior missions and literature.
mcp: Inject precise, real-time computation and knowledge

MCP server for LLM to drone communication via MAVLink
